name: No One Is Perfect
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that no one on earth is truly perfect or without sin, as Ecclesiastes 7:20 affirms that no just man does good without sinning. Human wisdom and self-righteousness are cautioned against, with Proverbs 26:12 warning that a man wise in his own conceit has less hope than a fool. Jesus Himself declares in Mark 10:18 that only God is truly good, emphasizing our need for divine grace. Yet, believers are called to strive for the perfection of God (Matthew 5:48) and to live by the golden rule of treating others as we wish to be treated (Luke 6:31), relying on God’s love demonstrated through the gift of His Son for salvation (John 3:16).
